scope: Customer sell flow derives entries/build/parts from the public sell-taxonomy API so the admin 'Active' toggle takes effect end-to-end

businessFlow.subject: Customer /sell entry chooser and build/part wizards render from server taxonomy; inactive entries are hidden

notes: Verified headed against the local dev stack (web :3000, api :4000). Public GET /api/v1/sell-taxonomy returns only is_active entries and /sell renders that exact set (is_active=false hid Laptop/Laptop Parts; flipping them true surfaced them immediately). Laptop build roles (Laptop RAM*/Laptop Storage*/Battery/Keyboard/Charger/Screen) and Laptop Parts child categories render from API components/children, not hardcoded constants.
